# onpager_delivery_channel (Data Source)

Read one OnPager delivery channel through authorized configuration reads. Absence, ambiguity and denied reads are errors. Reads never modify configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "channel_id" {
  description = "Known delivery channel UUID, distinct from any catalog binding UUID."
  type        = string
}

data "onpager_delivery_channel" "example" {
  id = var.channel_id
}

output "channel_enabled" {
  value = data.onpager_delivery_channel.example.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Known delivery channel UUID, distinct from catalog binding UUIDs. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID. This data source performs no name search or external target discovery.

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (Set of String) Observed provider capabilities; empty when the provider is unavailable.
- `contract_version` (String) Observed channel provider contract version.
- `display_name` (String) Observed channel display name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Observed enabled state. Disabled channels remain readable.
- `kind` (String) Observed channel provider kind.
- `unavailable_reason` (String) Observed unavailability reason, such as `provider_unavailable`; an empty string means no reason was reported. Only safe channel metadata is exposed; no credentials, config or target addresses enter state.

## Selection

Set `id` to a known delivery channel UUID. A delivery channel UUID differs from
a team or service catalog binding UUID. This data source has no name selector
and does not discover delivery channels or messenger targets.

## Read behavior

Reads channel metadata, including disabled channels. Credential references,
secrets, target addresses and target snapshots are excluded. An unavailable
channel provider is reported through `unavailable_reason`; an unknown channel
provider returns `provider_unavailable` with no capabilities.

Missing channels, denied access, malformed responses and transport failures
produce diagnostics.

## Permissions

Requires the tenant grant `delivery_channels.read` for personal tokens and
service accounts. Credential-reference and target-address grants are not
required.
